hero.name: MD Kazi Jawadul Islam
typedRoles: B.Sc Student in Computing & Information System

about.bio:
A motivated and detail-oriented Business Analyst with experience in business process analysis, project coordination, digital transformation, and technology-driven business solutions. I have hands-on experience working with CRM, HRM, project management, workflow automation, data collection, reporting, and website development projects, with a strong focus on identifying business requirements and converting them into practical solutions.

I am passionate about using technology to improve organizational efficiency, streamline business processes, and support data-driven decision-making. I also have experience contributing to digital marketing, social media management, content planning, and corporate branding initiatives. Alongside my professional experience, I have worked on an AI-based legal research project involving semantic search, document summarization, and data-driven analysis.

I am a fast learner, problem solver, and team-oriented professional who continuously seeks opportunities to develop my technical, analytical, and business skills while contributing meaningful value to an organization.
